purpose: Schema for a future BigQMT 1m/5m candidate overlay; not a published lake table
storage_target: runtime_data/evidence or quant_data_lake/_staging only after all gates pass

columns.bar_time: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE; Asia/Shanghai bar-end time
columns.adjustment_mode: VARCHAR; none only in raw candidate
columns.source_release: VARCHAR; immutable QMT cache evidence id

quality_rules.ohlc: positive and high >= max(open, low, close), low <= min(open, high, close)
quality_rules.time: strictly increasing within code+period+trade_date; no duplicate bar_time
quality_rules.cross_period_reconciliation: intraday volume/amount sum approximately equals same-day 1d raw QMT bar
quality_rules.adjustment: raw candidate uses dividend_type=none; front/back diagnostic only
quality_rules.pit: available_at must not be after the observation/use timestamp
